gaps_attempted.notes: No experimentally demonstrated rep rate or yield above chi~0.1 found in public literature. The gap reflects a genuine experimental state — no Z Machine experiment has operated rep-rated or demonstrated higher gain. The AIP 'Progress and issues with pulsed magnetic fusion' (Pop 32:2, Feb 2025) is the most likely source for any updated experimental data but is paywalled.

candidates.title: Analysis of Preheat Propagation in MagLIF-like Plasmas (arXiv:2504.11432)
candidates.notes: Analyzes preheat dynamics within existing MagLIF design. Does not address laser preheat elimination — assumes preheat as given and models its effects.

candidates.title: Pacific Fusion Experimental Breakthrough (Feb 2026)
candidates.notes: Directly states that laser preheat is NOT yet eliminated: 'in the next iteration of experiments, we will aim to show that we can eliminate the need for laser pre-heating in addition to pre-magnetization.' Establishes current state and near-term direction. Source already extracted (iter-03).

candidates.title: Pacific Fusion and General Atomics Team Up to Deliver Breakthroughs in IFE (GlobeNewsWire, April 2025)
candidates.notes: Mentions GA role in target fabrication, module reliability (100 consecutive tests/day), 2 TW per module, 250 MWe commercial plant footprint. Does not address laser preheat specifically.

gaps_attempted.notes: Laser preheat elimination is an aspirational next step for Pacific Fusion, not yet demonstrated. The Pacific Fusion experimental breakthrough source (already extracted) is the primary source establishing this status. G-13 represents a genuine frontier — no peer-reviewed paper addresses laser-free MagLIF feasibility at commercial yields because no one has demonstrated it experimentally yet. The AIP paper on self-magnetizing DSP-driven MagLIF (paywalled) would be the closest academic analog.

summary.notes: One attempted extraction (Pacific Fusion experimental breakthrough) returned 'already exists' — it was previously extracted in iter-03 but not yet integrated into the analysis. Two new sources were successfully extracted: (1) GlobeNewsWire Pacific Fusion + General Atomics press release covering commercial plant parameters and module reliability; (2) ANS article on Pacific Fusion + GA partnership with commercial plant scale data (~250 MWe on ~25 acres). G-3 (rep rate demonstration) has no accessible public source — gap reflects genuine experimental state. G-1 (IMG plant study) has no formal study in public literature; partial data from ANS article.
